meta.name: astropy
meta.description: Core Python library for astronomy and astrophysics workflows that need Astropy APIs, including units/quantities, coordinates, FITS I/O, tables, time systems, WCS, and cosmology. Use when implementing or debugging astronomical data analysis code with Astropy.

copy.tagline: 实现天文天体物理数据的处理与数值计算
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要用 Python 处理天文观测数据或天体物理数值计算。
copy.tagline_en: Compute astronomical data with units, coordinates, and FITS in Python
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with astronomical observations or astrophysics data in Python.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在帮你用 Astropy 编写或调试天文数据分析代码时,会按库的真实 API 给出可用的 Python 写法,内容覆盖单位与量、坐标转换、FITS 文件、星表、时间尺度、宇宙学、WCS 等模块。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 用 Astropy 实现或调试天文数据分析代码,比如坐标转换、FITS 文件读写、宇宙学计算等时触发。

say.text: 写段 Astropy 代码,把 ICRS 坐标转成银道坐标。
say.note: Claude 会返回坐标变换示例。

say.text: 用 Planck18 写代码算 z=1.5 的光度距离和回溯时间。
say.note: Claude 会返回宇宙学计算示例。

howto.what_en: With this skill, when you ask Claude to write or debug astronomical data-analysis code using Astropy, it follows the library's actual API and provides usable Python snippets covering units and quantities, coordinate transforms, FITS files, tables, time scales, cosmology, and WCS.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you ask Claude to implement or debug astronomical data-analysis code with Astropy, typically for coordinate transforms, FITS file I/O, or cosmology calculations.

say_en.text: Write Astropy code to transform ICRS coordinates to Galactic coordinates.
Write Astropy code to read example.fits and list its HDU structure.
say_en.note: Claude gives an example using fits.open.

say_en.text: Write Planck18 code for luminosity distance and lookback time at z=1.5.
say_en.note: Claude returns a cosmology calculation example.
